props.characteristic: every unit is wired to every unit of the adjacent group
props.positive_test: the layer applies a full weight matrix with no structural sparsity
props.negative_test: the wiring is constrained by locality, position, a graph, or time

props.characteristic: an unconstrained dense weight matrix
props.positive_test: the layer is a plain matmul plus nonlinearity
props.negative_test: the matrix is constrained to a low-rank or factorized form
props.examples: MLP; feedforward block of a Transformer

props.characteristic: the dense map is constrained to a product of smaller factors
props.positive_test: the weights are stored and applied as a product of lower-rank terms
props.negative_test: the matrix is unconstrained
props.notes: Lineage families like matrix factorization pin this.

props.characteristic: units share weights across positions of a regular grid
props.positive_test: the same kernel is applied at every position
props.negative_test: weights are position-specific, or the domain is an irregular graph

props.characteristic: a dense kernel over all input channels
props.positive_test: one kernel mixes space and channels together
props.negative_test: space and channels are mixed in separate stages, or the kernel is spaced out

props.characteristic: spatial mixing and channel mixing are separate stages
props.positive_test: a depthwise step is followed by a pointwise step
props.negative_test: one kernel does both at once

props.characteristic: the kernel samples positions at a stride greater than one
props.positive_test: receptive field grows without extra parameters or pooling
props.negative_test: the kernel reads contiguous positions

props.characteristic: the wiring weights are computed from the content of the inputs
props.positive_test: which units talk is decided per example by a similarity score
props.negative_test: the wiring is fixed by position, grid or graph before seeing the input

props.characteristic: queries, keys and values all come from one sequence
props.positive_test: the layer relates a sequence to itself
props.negative_test: queries come from one stream and keys from another

props.characteristic: queries come from one stream, keys and values from another
props.positive_test: the layer relates two distinct streams
props.negative_test: both sides are the same stream

props.characteristic: units are wired to their own state at the previous step
props.positive_test: the computation carries a state along a sequence and reuses one set of weights
props.negative_test: the sequence is processed in parallel with no carried state

props.characteristic: learned gates control what the state keeps and forgets
props.positive_test: multiplicative gates mediate the state update
props.negative_test: the state update is linear and time-invariant

props.characteristic: the state update is a linear dynamical system
props.positive_test: the recurrence is linear, so it can also be run as a convolution or scan
props.negative_test: gates make the update input-dependent and nonlinear

props.characteristic: units are wired by the edges of an irregular graph
props.positive_test: each unit aggregates from its graph neighbours
props.negative_test: the neighbourhood is a regular grid, or all units are neighbours

props.characteristic: aggregation is defined through the graph Laplacian spectrum
props.positive_test: the operator is a polynomial of the Laplacian
props.negative_test: aggregation is defined directly on neighbours in the spatial domain

props.characteristic: aggregation is defined directly over neighbours
props.positive_test: messages are computed per edge and pooled per node
props.negative_test: the operator is defined in the spectral domain

props.characteristic: all units are pooled into one with no ordering or adjacency
props.positive_test: a permutation-invariant pool reduces a set to a fixed-size vector
props.negative_test: the inputs carry an order, a grid position, or edges
props.notes: Added 2026-10-02: the axis had no value for a pooling stack. Distinct from message passing, which needs edges.

props.characteristic: the output is produced by evaluating learned discrete conditions
props.positive_test: prediction follows from tests that are true or false, not from a weighted sum
props.negative_test: the output is a weighted combination of continuous activations

props.characteristic: the conditions are arranged as a hierarchy of splits
props.positive_test: one root-to-leaf path decides the output
props.negative_test: the conditions are an unordered or flat set

props.characteristic: the conditions are a flat list of if-then rules
props.positive_test: rules are matched in order or by coverage, not by descending a tree
props.negative_test: the conditions form a hierarchy
props.examples: decision lists; rule sets; ILP hypotheses
props.notes: Added 2026-10-02: the lineage pinning pass found Rule-based model unpinnable.

props.characteristic: units are wired by a factor graph over random variables
props.positive_test: the structure states which variables share a factor
props.negative_test: the structure wires deterministic activations rather than variables
props.notes: Added 2026-10-02: no value existed for probabilistic graphical models.

props.characteristic: the wiring follows a tree given by the input itself
props.positive_test: the same cell is applied bottom-up over a parse or syntax tree
props.negative_test: the structure is fixed in advance, or carried along a flat sequence
props.notes: Added 2026-10-02. Distinct from recurrence, where the structure is a chain fixed in advance.

props.characteristic: the map is a learned integral kernel between function spaces
props.positive_test: the layer acts on a function and is discretization-invariant
props.negative_test: the layer acts on a fixed-size vector of features
props.notes: Added 2026-10-02: the Neural operator lineage was unpinnable.

props.characteristic: the input is compared against stored reference points
props.positive_test: prediction is a weighted sum of kernel evaluations against training data
props.negative_test: the model holds a fixed parameter vector independent of the data
